entities.summary: Islamic, a notable figure in the history of Morocco, associated with Ancient and Medieval Morocco (789–985). Preceded by Idrisid Dynasty — First Moroccan State and Roman Volubilis. Their legacy influenced Almoravid Dynasty and Berber Saharan.
